_comment: GENERATED-ADJACENT: this is the fragment scripts/qwen-settings.mjs merges into
$QWEN_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json. Qwen extensions cannot carry hooks, so unlike
the Claude plugin's hooks.json this file is not loaded by the host directly —
the installer copies it in, rewriting AGENTIC_WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ROOT to an
absolute path. The four events mirror the Claude plugin exactly; only the
PreToolUse matcher differs, because the tool ids do.
ONE INTENTIONAL ASYMMETRY: build-hooks.mjs also emits stamp-spawn-model.mjs
into this directory, and it is deliberately NOT registered here. Qwen's
`agent` tool has no `model` parameter to stamp into, so the binding happens
at install time instead (scripts/qwen-agents.mjs bakes `model:` into each
copied agent file). The hook no-ops under AGENTIC_WORKFLOW_HOST=qwen anyway
— pinned by a test — so registering it later would be safe, not wrong.
